author: trackreco
body:
#### PR description:

This PR adds MkFinderV2p2, a new implementation of mkFit's layer processing and hit selection, and uses it wherever mkFit builds tracks in Phase-2:
- the offline initialStep (default setup);
- the HLT initialStep (LST + mkFit);
- the offline LST + mkFit setup: the LST step (highPtTripletStep) and, with `cms-sw/cmssw#52464`, the pre-splitting initialStep.

The clone engine, mkFit's builder until now, stays available (`buildingRoutine = 'cloneEngine'`). Its results change through three changes to shared code (commits 1 and 2): the vectorised `fast_sincos()` in `applyMaterialEffects()`, which rounds differently in CMSSW's build; vdt's sin and cos throughout the helix propagation (`sincos4` and `Config::useTrigApprox` removed); and the backward search, which now adds back the hole counts set aside at its start before its final sort, so that its candidates are ranked as whole tracks.

Main changes:
- Layer processing: each layer is entered through its two bounding-surface crossings, and a cubic Hermite model between them gives the crossing with each hit's own module plane without a propagation per hit. The search window comes from the track covariance, transported analytically to the layer, and from each hit's own extent; its phi margin is capped at 0.05 rad.
- In-layer combinatorial search: the hits of a layer are taken in the order the track crosses them, and one candidate can take several of them, such as hits on overlapping modules. At the end of each layer all in-layer hit sequences, holes and stopped candidates of a seed compete in one selection on a log-likelihood score.
- Kalman updates are composed from the steps in `PlaneSteps.h` (`cms-sw/cmssw#52259`) and run in batches computed over all lanes of a Matriplex, so that a result does not depend on how full its batch is. In the search, updates with a negative chi2, or with a residual covariance whose determinant is not positive, are rejected.
- MkFinderV2p2 has its own backward fit, which fits every hit on track, overlap hits included (the clone engine's plane fit skips them); of the two sensors of a module pair, the one the track meets first is fitted first. The pairs come from `LayerNumberConverter` (Phase-1 and Phase-2).
- Configuration:
  - `MkFitProducer`'s `buildingRoutine` selects the builder (`'v2p2'`; the default stays `'cloneEngine'`).
  - Per-iteration tunings in a `v2p2` PSet of `MkFitIterationConfigESProducer`: the likelihood's hit efficiencies, the hit acceptance (`hitChi2Cut`, `hitChi2TrackFactor`), the pre-selection cap, the hits per layer, the window factors on the track errors, and a hole rule for short seeds (`outsideHoleMaxSeedHits`: for seeds of at most that many hits, a layer the candidate does not reach counts as a hole until its first hit beyond the seed). The offline LST step uses `outsideHoleMaxSeedHits = 3` and `hitChi2TrackFactor = 1`; elsewhere the defaults.
  - Track scorers are named per task (final pick, after the backward fit, duplicate cleaner) in the iteration JSON, which therefore needs the JSONs of `cms-data/RecoTracker-MkFit#24`.
- Duplicate cleaner: the tracks are sorted by polar angle and only the pairs within the polar window are compared, not every pair, in the pixel-seed, pixel-priority and pT-adaptive (`cms-sw/cmssw#51847`) variants. Without the direction cut (`dc_drth_*` = 0: the pT-adaptive cleaner at the HLT, and in the offline LST step with `cms-data/RecoTracker-MkFit#23`), only the pairs that share a hit are compared, as master does. It keeps the same tracks as master's cleaner; the offline initialStep's cleaner takes 12 ms per ttbar PU200 event, against 55 ms in master.
- Fixes in shared code that act in the setups now run by MkFinderV2p2 (commits 1, 2 and 7):
  - when the two roots of the plane solve are within a factor of about 50, the plane propagation takes the one landing nearer the module centre;
  - after the backward fit's outlier rejection the hole and overlap counts are recounted;
  - the gate of `cms-sw/cmssw#52015` now runs in the post-search filter, after the repack, and restores the complete forward candidate, hole counts and score included;
  - the seed-hit count has 6 bits (LST seeds of more than 15 hits wrapped).

The design and the measurements behind each default are in `RecoTracker/MkFitCore/doc/MkFinderV2p2-DesignNotes.md`, also rendered [here](https://desire.physics.ucsd.edu/mkfit/mkfit-pog-197-2026-11-23/doc/mkfinderv2p2-design-notes.html). The standalone build of mkFit has moved to `trackreco/mkFit-external`. MkFitCore's standalone-only code now refers to headers that exist only there, so the in-tree standalone copies no longer build; `cms-sw/cmssw#52636` removes them.

Commits 3-6 and the validation by Mario Masciovecchio; code review and fixes from Slava Krutelyov and Gavin Niendorf.

For more details: [Tracking POG, 23 Nov 2026](https://desire.physics.ucsd.edu/mkfit/mkfit-pog-197-2026-11-23/).

#### Commits

Seven commits, each by its author:
1. Add MkFinderV2p2 (M. Tadel).
2. Fixes shared with the clone engine: the plane-root choice, the hole recount after the outlier rejection, the vectorised sincos (M. Tadel).
3. Duplicate cleaner: pT-adaptive pairs as in master (M. Masciovecchio).
4. Phase-2 HLT: MkFinderV2p2 in the LST + mkFit initialStep (M. Masciovecchio).
5. Per-iteration search-window factors and a hole rule for short seeds (M. Masciovecchio).
6. Phase-2 offline LST + mkFit: MkFinderV2p2 in the pre-splitting initialStep and the LST step (M. Masciovecchio).
7. Follow-ups: window factors read once, 6-bit seed-hit count, padded pre-selection lanes, two Newton steps (M. Tadel).

Commit 4 shows how a step is switched to MkFinderV2p2 (`buildingRoutine = 'v2p2'`); commit 6 also gives a step its own settings in the `v2p2` PSet.

#### Dependencies

- Needs `cms-data/RecoTracker-MkFit#24`: the loader requires the new per-task scorer keys. #24 also sets the final pick to `v2p2:llh` and the backward-search start layers in the Phase-2 initialStep and both LST JSONs. The JSON, not the builder, chooses the scorer: the clone engine run on these JSONs also ranks its final pick by `v2p2:llh`.
- The offline LST + mkFit setup runs as validated only together with `cms-sw/cmssw#52464`. Without it the pre-splitting initialStep's mkFit module gets `v2p2` but is not scheduled, and its configuration names the Phase-1 JSON; #52464 gives it the Phase-2 JSON. The LST step itself, the default offline reconstruction and the HLT do not depend on it, and this PR builds without it.
- `cms-data/RecoTracker-MkFit#23` (the pT-adaptive cleaner in the offline LST JSON) was used in the offline LST validation below; it is not required, and it merges clean with #24.
- Independent of `cms-sw/cmssw#52636`; the two apply clean together.

#### PR validation:

- reference: CMSSW_20_1_0_pre5 with `cms-sw/cmssw#52259` (since merged);
- ttbar, QCD Pt 1800-2400 and Z'->mumu, PU200, CPU only;
- efficiency, fake and duplicate rates as in standard MTV, in %;
- "CKF fit": initialStepTracks from the CKF final fit (default); "mkFit fit": from the mkFit final fit (procModifier `trackingMkFitFit`).

**Offline initialStep, default setup** (1000 events, an earlier state of this PR; the later fixes from the review move the initialStep by a few tracks):

| ttbar | reference, CKF fit | this PR, CKF fit | reference, mkFit fit | this PR, mkFit fit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| initialStep efficiency | 69.50 | 69.71 | 69.44 | 69.71 |
| initialStep fake rate | 1.55 | 1.08 | 1.70 | 1.11 |
| initialStep duplicate rate | 0.03 | 0.08 | 0.03 | 0.08 |
| generalTracks efficiency | 92.26 | 92.38 | 92.21 | 92.38 |
| generalTracks fake rate | 13.13 | 12.82 | 13.24 | 12.83 |

The duplicate rate rises from 0.03 to 0.08 %, while fake plus duplicate, as MTV plots it, falls from 1.58 to 1.16 %. QCD and Z'->mumu show the same. With this PR the CKF and mkFit fits agree within 0.04 points in the fake rates and 0.1 in the efficiencies. MTV plots: [1000 events](https://uaf-10.t2.ucsd.edu/~mmasciov/MIC/Phase2/FitBiasWithC/22_pr197/index.html), [100 events, clone engine and MkFinderV2p2](https://xrd-cache-1.t2.ucsd.edu/matevz/PKF/mkfit-197-mtv-2026-11-18/).

**HLT initialStep, LST + mkFit** (hltGeneralTracks, 100 events, an earlier state of this PR; with 1000 events MkFinderV2p2's efficiency is 0.09-0.17 points above the clone engine's):

| | clone engine, CKF fit | V2p2, CKF fit | clone engine, mkFit fit | V2p2, mkFit fit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ttbar efficiency | 91.40 | 91.45 | 91.24 | 91.38 |
| ttbar fake rate | 1.09 | 1.00 | 1.10 | 1.01 |
| QCD efficiency | 90.15 | 90.22 | 89.97 | 90.05 |
| QCD fake rate | 1.40 | 1.30 | 1.40 | 1.29 |
| Z'->mumu efficiency | 90.27 | 90.27 | 90.14 | 90.19 |
| Z'->mumu fake rate | 1.12 | 1.03 | 1.16 | 1.06 |

MTV plots: [with LST and at the HLT](https://uaf-10.t2.ucsd.edu/~mmasciov/MIC/Phase2/FitBiasWithC/23_lst197/).

**Offline LST + mkFit setup** (generalTracks, 1000 events, CKF fit, with `cms-data/RecoTracker-MkFit#23`):

| | clone engine | V2p2 |
|---|---|---|
| ttbar high purity, efficiency / fake rate | 93.04 / 6.50 | 93.08 / 6.15 |
| QCD high purity, efficiency / fake rate | 92.78 / 6.49 | 92.77 / 6.15 |
| ttbar all tracks, efficiency / fake rate | 93.65 / 11.68 | 93.73 / 13.55 |
| QCD all tracks, efficiency / fake rate | 93.24 / 11.66 | 93.25 / 13.55 |

- high purity: 0.35 points fewer fakes than with the clone engine, at the same efficiency;
- all tracks: 1.9 points more fakes, short tracks from the bare pixel triplets that the LST step also gets offline (about 9700 bare pixel triplets per event offline, 13 at the HLT); the high-purity selection removes them;
- the fake rates are the same in ttbar and QCD: these fakes are dominated by pileup.

MTV plots: [offline LST step with its settings](https://uaf-10.t2.ucsd.edu/~mmasciov/MIC/Phase2/FitBiasWithC/24_lst197tune/).

**Timing** (ttbar PU200, one thread):
- offline initialStep building, `initialStepTrackCandidatesMkFit`: 427 ms per event with MkFinderV2p2, 465 with the clone engine (Xeon Gold 6130, 51 events, minimum of 3 runs); against the reference, 672 -> 469 ms (-30 %; M. Masciovecchio, 100 events, AMD EPYC 7763). Of the shared changes, the vectorised `fast_sincos()` alone takes either finder's building to 0.89 of its time, 11 % less (Xeon Gold 6130, 51 events);
- HLT building: 48.3 ms per event in the reference, 37.6 with the clone engine and 36.2 with MkFinderV2p2 after this PR (M. Masciovecchio, AMD EPYC 7763); the clone engine's gain comes from the shared changes;
- offline LST step: building 635 -> 484 ms from the clone engine to MkFinderV2p2, measured before the LST step's two settings; the extra short tracks then cost about as much again in the fit: whole job +3 % with the CKF fit.

FYI: @cms-sw/tracking-pog-l2, @slava77, @mmasciov, @GNiendorf
title: mkFit: MkFinderV2p2 track finding with an in-layer search, for all Phase-2 mkFit steps
